title: Sargon besieges Ashdod
summary: Sargon sends his tartan against Ashdod (Isa 20:1).
description: Sargon sends his tartan against Ashdod (Isa 20:1). The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 713 BC. Sort changed by the Reply to Beckman pass (2026-11-13): was ussher-jones 713 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 1, row 713, p. 39; Table 3, row 713, p. 44
chronologies.note: Sargon II’s Ashdod campaign (Isaiah 20:1) in Hezekiah year 14, Sennacherib as vice-regent. The authors hold Sargon’s annalists moved it down a year, to 712.

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
